newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIA STOCKS RISE LED BY BREWING BLUE-CHIP.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIA STOCKS RISE LED BY BREWING BLUE-CHIP.

text.p: Colombian stocks rose Wednesday led by demand for blue-chip brewing giant Bavaria.
Bogota's IBB index gained 0.96 percent to 1,240.61 amid a 2.3 billion peso volume while Medellin's IBOMED general price index ended up 0.96 percent at 18,831.11 amid a 7.2 billion peso volume.
"The stock market is being driven by the small drop in interest rates and that's helped sustain the recovery," one Bogota dealer said.
Bavaria, flagship of the Santo Domingo group, rose 2.7 percent to 9,400 in Bogota and it climbed 3.39 percent to 9,450 in Medellin.
"This stock is extremely liquid and has advanced without problems although we think it may soon reach its ceiling," one Medellin trader said.
One of the day's biggest fallers was cement maker Cementos Paz del Rio. It fell 2.6 percent to 1,120 in Bogota and 3.03 percent to 1,120.01 in Medellin.
